_configs_note: Snapshot only — not load-bearing. The '-XXXX' suffixes are account-specific and regenerated on each setup-evaluations.sh run; consumers read evalConfigName from agents.json, which refresh-agents-json.sh repopulates by querying live CW log groups. Keys use the canonical long form 'eval_<agentId>' (e.g. eval_agentcore_hub_requirements_analyst), matching what setup-evaluations.sh creates.
_reapply_note: TEAM-3376: the live account configs still carry the OLD 10-evaluator/100% matrix until an operator runs the reconciliation procedure in setup-evaluations.sh (list -> delete mismatched -> refresh-agents-json.sh -> re-run script). Re-record the resulting config ids here afterwards — do not paste ids that haven't been created.

notes.sampling: Tiered sampling keeps the Opus judge under its RPM quota. If throttling persists anyway, see 'Eval judge throttling (quota)' in docs/orchestration-tracing-guide.md for the operator quota-increase runbook.

notes.max_evaluators: API limit is 10 evaluators per config; TEAM-3366 §2.4 trimmed every config to 5 to cut Opus-judge load.
